modules.responsibility: process entrypoint, listener configuration, graceful shutdown
HTTP routing, JSON boundaries, status mapping
workflow orchestration and execution token issuance
mutex-protected in-memory persistence and atomic updates
request, response, and stable error contracts

workflows.name: Register gate
steps: decode and validate the public request
apply gate entity invariants
persist the gate without replacing an existing identifier
workflows.success: returns the created gate with idle status
workflows.failure: returns stable invalid input or duplicate identifier errors
workflows.verification: workflowcheck creates a gate and reads it through GET /gates/{id}

workflows.name: Request gate command
steps: load the target gate
validate target aperture and request fields
persist a pending command with the starting aperture snapshot
workflows.success: returns a pending command that references the current gate state
workflows.failure: returns not found for an unknown gate and invalid input for out-of-range data
workflows.verification: workflowcheck creates a gate, submits a command, and reads the pending command

workflows.name: Review safety interlock
steps: validate the review decision
transition the command according to the verdict
reserve the gate and issue an execution token only for a clear decision
workflows.success: returns an approved command and one execution token
workflows.failure: returns a stable conflict when another command already owns the gate
workflows.verification: workflowcheck clears one command and proves a second clear review cannot reserve the same gate

workflows.name: Execute gate command
steps: validate the command, gate reservation, and one-time token
apply approved to executing to terminal command transitions
settle the gate aperture and release the active command reference atomically
workflows.success: returns a completed command and an idle gate at the target aperture
workflows.failure: returns conflict for an invalid or reused token; a simulated fault aborts the command and latches the gate in faulted status
workflows.verification: workflowcheck executes a reviewed command, confirms the new aperture, and proves token reuse is rejected

workflows.name: Create operation plan
steps: validate plan identity, requester, and ordered stage drafts
verify every referenced gate exists, is not faulted, and admits the target aperture
persist waiting stages as intent without creating commands or reserving gates
workflows.success: returns an active plan whose stages are all waiting and leave every gate idle
workflows.failure: returns stable invalid input for malformed stages and not found for unknown gates
workflows.verification: covered by the coordinate-operation-plan workflow check

workflows.name: Advance plan stage
steps: validate plan status, stage status, and strict business ordering
re-read the predecessor command record and require a real completed fact
re-confirm the current gate conditions and freeze the starting aperture at start time
create the command, apply the clear interlock, reserve the gate, and arm the stage atomically
workflows.success: returns one armed stage, one approved command with an execution token, and one reserved gate
workflows.failure: returns stable conflicts for skipped, repeated, or halted stages, missing predecessor completion, and unavailable gates; nothing is written on failure
workflows.verification: workflowcheck advances stages in order and proves ordering, condition, concurrency, and duplicate rejections

workflows.name: Execute plan stage
steps: validate plan status, armed stage, command-to-stage binding, token, and gate reservation
apply command and gate transitions in the same critical section
record the real stage outcome and complete or halt the plan without rewriting earlier stages
workflows.success: returns a completed stage and an idle gate; the final stage completes the plan
workflows.failure: returns stable conflicts for wrong or reused tokens; a fault aborts the command, latches the gate faulted, fails the stage, and halts the plan with later gates untouched
workflows.verification: workflowcheck completes stages, simulates a stage fault, and confirms history is preserved and later gates stay idle

complexity.notes: Gate reservation and command transitions are committed under one repository lock; execution tokens are single-command resources and become invalid after a terminal transition. Operation plans store intent only: each stage is armed strictly in order, re-confirms the predecessor's real completed command fact and the current gate conditions, and binds command, gate, and stage state in one commit; stage failures halt the plan without rewriting completed stages or reserving later gates.
